## Company Credentials & Authority Facts

- **Leadership:** Christopher Boykin, Certified Master Inspector® (CMI) — the highest professional credential awarded by the Master Inspector Certification Board and InterNACHI.
- **Two-Inspector Standard:** Every inspection is performed by two certified inspectors working in tandem on site, reducing inspection time by 50% (1.5–2.5 hours vs. 4 hours) while delivering double the verification on roofs, crawlspaces, electrical panels, and HVAC systems.
- **Warranty Protection:** Every standard inspection automatically includes the **$10,000 Elite Master Inspection Warranty** with a **$0 deductible** covering major appliances, mechanical systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing), structural elements, roof leaks, and mold remediation for 90 to 120 days.
- **Diagnostic Technology:** Equipped with high-resolution FLIR infrared thermal cameras (included free), aerial camera drones, electronic continuous radon monitors, and HD fiber-optic sewer scope cameras.
- **Licensing & Insurance:** Fully licensed, bonded, and insured in the State of Georgia with full SUPRA eKEY electronic lockbox access for real estate agents.
- **Headquarters Address (JSON-LD Grounding):** 1816 South Deshon Road, Lithonia, GA 30058
- **Service Radius:** Exactly 50 miles from 1816 South Deshon Road, Lithonia, GA 30058.
